# Nanbeige4.3-33B

Nanbeige · released 2026-10

Flagship 'teacher' model of the Nanbeige4.3 series (card), post-trained from Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B-Base (card base\_model). HF repo created 2026-10-24 (weights uploaded 2026-10-24; pinned README commit df919e1 on 2026-10-28). Text only; thinking on by default (enable\_thinking), reported evals use preserve\_thinking=true. Contact address on the card is nanbeige@kanzhun.com. Licence: apache-2.0 in the card's YAML metadata; the repo has no LICENSE file. No official API and no official Ollama library entry (ollama.com/library/nanbeige and /nanbeige4.3 returned 404 on 2026-11-12). Official card documents Transformers, SGLang and vLLM (tensor parallel 4) with a local MODEL\_PATH placeholder, so those are not listed as copy-pasteable routes. Benchmark comparison columns are Nanbeige re-runs of other models and are not used.

## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Nanbeige4.3-33B (Q4_K_M, needs 23.3 GB memory, 20.8 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF/blob/9beb68421fdf7be095093a6888325fa2c83ddd38/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (38.5 GB memory, 35.2 GB download) `llama cli -hf bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Nanbeige4.3-33B (Q4_K_M, needs 23.3 GB memory, 20.8 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF/blob/9beb68421fdf7be095093a6888325fa2c83ddd38/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (38.5 GB memory, 35.2 GB download) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Nanbeige4.3-33B (Q4_K_M, needs 23.3 GB memory, 20.8 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF/blob/9beb68421fdf7be095093a6888325fa2c83ddd38/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run hf.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (38.5 GB memory, 35.2 GB download) `ollama run hf.co/bartowski/Nanbeige_Nanbeige4.3-33B-GGUF:Q8_0`
